issues.label: AOM validity under MCL 600.2912d
issues.why: The court must determine whether the affidavit of merit was valid given Dr. Bal's expert qualifications.

issues.label: Dr. Bal's qualifications to sign AOM
issues.why: Whether Dr. Bal met the one-year practice/teaching requirement given evidence he retired in 2017.

issues.label: Reasonable-belief standard for AOM signer
issues.why: Whether counsel need only a reasonable belief the signer is qualified at the time of signing.

issues.label: Consequence of invalid AOM
issues.why: Whether an invalid AOM renders the complaint legally deficient and warrants dismissal, and with what prejudice.

issues.label: Extrinsic evidence to challenge AOM
issues.why: Whether outside deposition/trial testimony and LinkedIn may be used to attack the affidavit's assertions.

issues.label: Summary disposition burden shifting
issues.why: Whether plaintiff produced evidence creating a genuine issue of material fact on qualification after discovery closed.

issues.label: Proper summary disposition subrule
issues.why: The court must apply the correct standard (e.g., MCR 2.116(C)(10)) governing the AOM challenge.

issues.label: Credibility versus admissibility distinction
issues.why: Whether the challenge is an improper credibility attack rather than a proper qualification challenge.

issues.label: Dean v Tucker sanction factors
issues.why: The court must weigh each factor before barring the substitute witness or effectively dismissing the claim.

issues.label: Amendment of witness list MCR 2.401(I)
issues.why: Whether plaintiff showed good cause to add Dr. Hall and remove Dr. Bal.

issues.label: Timeliness relative to scheduling deadlines
issues.why: Whether the amended scheduling order extended the witness-list deadline or only the discovery cutoff.

issues.label: Good cause for substituting expert
issues.why: Whether Dr. Bal's alleged uncooperativeness was genuine or a pretext for unqualification.

issues.label: Prejudice to defendants from amendment
issues.why: Whether allowing substitution near trial unfairly prejudices defendants' preparation.

issues.label: Effect of improperly filed amended list
issues.why: Whether filing without leave was a nullity requiring a motion to amend.

issues.label: Voluntary dismissal under MCR 2.504(A)
issues.why: Whether plaintiff met the requirements for dismissal without prejudice after answers were filed.

issues.label: Discretion to deny voluntary dismissal
issues.why: Whether the court properly denied dismissal to prevent circumventing the AOM challenge.

issues.label: Plaintiff's diligence in prosecuting case
issues.why: Whether plaintiff's delay in resolving expert issues justifies denial of relief.

issues.label: Compliance with order to produce Dr. Bal
issues.why: Whether plaintiff's failure to produce Dr. Bal for deposition warrants sanctions.

issues.label: Vicarious liability claims survival
issues.why: Whether dismissal of the malpractice claim disposes of claims against Tri County and Beaumont.

issues.label: Motion for reconsideration standard
issues.why: Whether plaintiff demonstrated palpable error to warrant reconsideration.

issues.label: Statute of limitations impact
issues.why: Whether dismissal effectively bars refiling, making 'without prejudice' illusory and heightening prejudice.

issues.label: Mootness of motion to compel
issues.why: Whether withdrawing Dr. Bal mooted the need to depose him about AOM qualifications.
